title: Qatl hogaya saqqa tashnalab sakina hai
body:
QATAL HOGAYA SAQQA TASHNA LAB SAKINA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
NOUJAWAAN PYASE HAI BE ZUBAAN PYASE HAI, HAR KISI KE HOTOU PAR PYAS KE UJALE HAI, IBNE ZEHRA PYAASA HAI LEHREY LETA DARIYA HAI, QATAL HOGAYA SAQQA TASHNA LAB SAKINA HAI
GULSHANE PAYAMBAR MAIN HAR TARAFUDASI HAI, KARBALA KE MAIDAN MEIN AAG SI BARASTI HAI, AHLEBAITH KE GHAR KA BACCHA BACCHA PASA HAI, QATAL HOGAYA SAQQA TASHNA LAB SAKINA HAI
AB NAHI ALI AKLBAR AUR NA QASIM-E-BEPAR, BETE BHANJE BHAI SAB GAYE LAB-E-KOUSAR, FATIMA KE PYARE KO ASHQIYAA NE GHERA HAI, QATAL HOGAYA SAQQA TASHNA LAB SAKINA HAI
KARBALA KE MAQTAL MEIN KYA UDASI CHAYI HAI, HASRATOU KE LAASHOU PAR ARZOO BHI ROTI HAI, EK PAHER KE DULHE KA KHOON SE LAAL SEHRA HAI, QATAL HOGAYA SAQQA TASHNA LAB SAKINA HAI
AB NA WO BARADAR HAIN AUR NA YAWAR-O-NASER, DIN-E-HAQ KI NUSHRAT MEIN QATAL HOGAYA LASHKAR, KOUN PAANI LAYEGA SHEH KA KHAIMA JALTA HAI
<<MINI>>
QATAL HOGAYA SAQQA TASHNA LAB SAKINA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
RO KE KEHTI THI ZAINAB BEKASI KE ALAM MAIN, KYA JIYEGI YE BEHNA BHAI TERE MATAM MAIN, BE KAFAN TERA LAASHA MERA SAR BAREHNA HAIN, QATAL HOGAYA SAQQA TASHNA LAB SAKINA HAI
HOGAYE RASAN BASTA SAR SE CHIN GAYI CHADAR, KAAN SE SAKINA KE HAYE CHIN GAYE GOUHAR, HAYE BINTE PAYAMBAR AAJ BE SAHARA HAI
<<MINI>>
QATAL HOGAYA SAQQA TASHNA LAB SAKINA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
CHAR SALA BACCHI KO GHAM HAZAROU SEHNE HAIN, GURKHIYA LAYEENOKI SHUMR KE TAMACHE HAIN, AB TOH USKI NAZROU CHAR SU ANDHERA HAI, QATAL HOGAYA SAQQA TASHNA LAB SAKINA HAI
QAID HOGAYE ABID SAR BA REHNA KUNBA HAI, ZALIMO KE NARGHE MEIN WARISE MADINA HAI, YA ALI MADAD KI JIYE SHEH KA LAAL TANHA HAI, QATAL HOGAYA SAQQA TASHNA LAB SAKINA HAI
SHEH KI LAADLI DUKHTAR JAA BALB HAI ZINDAAN MEIN, RUHE FATIMA MUZTAR MUZTARIB HAI ZINDAAN MEIN, AANSU KI CHADAR HAI KHAAK KA BICHONA HAI, QATAL HOGAYA SAQQA TASHNA LAB SAKINA HAI
